descriptionZh: 洗净后整根烤，不刷油；200°C 预热后放入，40 分钟起检查中心是否软透。
portionZh: 红薯 1 个；选择能平放进炸篮的一根
preheatDetailZh: 先将空气炸锅预热至 200°C，有就绪提示时等提示；主参考没有另列预热分钟数。
stepsZh: 刷洗红薯，保留整根。装好炸篮，将机器预热至 200°C。
把红薯放入炸篮，200°C 烤 40 分钟。
戴隔热手套拉出炸篮，用竹签或筷子扎入最厚处；仍有硬心就保持 200°C 继续加热，分段复查。
中心软透后，用夹子取出，稍放凉再掰开。
turnZh: 主参考没有单列翻面步骤，本份不另设固定翻面时间。
completionZh: 竹签或筷子能穿过最厚处，掰开中心也松软、没有硬心；到 40 分钟仍硬就继续烤。
deviceNoteZh: 主参考未注明机型与重量，40 分钟是该作者的检查参考；粗大的红薯可能需要继续加热。
notesZh: 本份照用作者的 200°C 预热后整根烤法，不采用飞利浦 HD9257 的冷启动参数。
独立对照 HD9257 为 6–9 个中等红薯、180°C 35 分钟、无需预热，并要求扎孔和翻动；份量、温度、设备及启动方式均不同，没有取平均。
完成检查与分段复查为编辑操作提示；尚未经过本站实机烹饪测试。

descriptionEn: Wash and roast whole without oil. Preheat to 200°C and start checking the center after 40 minutes.
portionEn: 1 sweet potato that fits flat in the basket
preheatDetailEn: Preheat to 200°C until the appliance is ready. The main source gives no separate preheat duration.

timelineEn.label: Wash
timelineEn.detail: Scrub off soil and rinse the skin.

timelineEn.label: Preheat
timelineEn.detail: 200°C, until the appliance is ready.

timelineEn.label: Air fry
timelineEn.detail: 200°C; start checking at 40 minutes.

stepsEn: Scrub the sweet potato and leave it whole. Assemble the basket and preheat to 200°C.
Place it in the basket and air fry at 200°C for 40 minutes.
Using heat-resistant gloves, pull out the basket. Pierce the thickest part with a skewer or chopstick. If the center is firm, continue at 200°C and check in short intervals.
Once soft through the center, remove with tongs and let cool slightly before splitting.
turnEn: The main source gives no turning step; no fixed turning time has been added.
completionEn: A skewer passes through the thickest part and the opened center is soft, with no firm core. Continue cooking if it is still firm at 40 minutes.
notesEn: This follows the author’s preheated 200°C method, not the cold-start settings of the Philips HD9257.

The independent HD9257 reference uses 6–9 medium sweet potatoes at 180°C for 35 minutes without preheating, with piercing and turning. Load, temperature, appliance and starting conditions differ; the settings were not averaged.
The doneness check and short-interval rechecks are editorial handling advice. This recipe has not been physically tested by this site.
deviceNoteEn: The main source names no model or weight. Treat 40 minutes as a checkpoint; a thicker sweet potato can need longer.

descriptionZh: 熟馒头切成约 1 厘米厚片，刷油撒粉；第一面烤 8 分钟，翻面再烤 5 分钟。
portionZh: 熟馒头 2 个；每批单层不重叠
preheatDetailZh: 主参考将馒头片装篮后开始加热，没有另列预热；本份保留这一顺序。
ingredientsZh: 已经蒸熟并放凉的馒头 2 个

timelineZh.label: 切片调味
timelineZh.detail: 切约 1 厘米厚片，单层摆放、刷油撒粉。

timelineZh.label: 翻面
timelineZh.detail: 补刷薄油、撒粉，180°C 再烤 5 分钟。

stepsZh: 把熟馒头切成约 1 厘米厚片。盐、孜然粉和可选辣椒粉先混合。
馒头片单层放入炸篮，不重叠，放不下分批。朝上的一面刷薄油，撒一部分调味粉。
180°C 烤 8 分钟后翻面。另一面补刷薄油、撒剩余调味粉，再烤 5 分钟。
检查表面是否干香、边缘酥脆；达到喜欢的程度即夹出，避免烤黑。
turnZh: 第 8 分钟翻面，再烤 5 分钟；油与调味粉分两面使用。
completionZh: 两面干香、边缘酥脆，馒头内部热透；不追求焦黑。
advancePreparationZh: 使用已经蒸熟、放凉的馒头，不适用于生面团。
notesZh: 10克油、1克盐、1克孜然粉、0.5克辣椒粉是编辑选定的调味用量，原文为适量或按口味，并非原作者量勺换算。
独立对照为裹鸡蛋液的薄片：180°C预热后4分钟、翻面2分钟；因裹层、厚度和做法不同，未采用其6分钟总时间。
尚未经过本站实机烹饪测试。

descriptionEn: Slice cooked mantou about 1 cm thick, brush with oil and season. Cook 8 minutes on the first side, then turn and cook 5 minutes.
portionEn: 2 cooked mantou; one non-overlapping layer per batch
preheatDetailEn: The main source loads the slices before starting and lists no separate preheat. That sequence is retained.

timelineEn.label: Slice and season
timelineEn.detail: Cut about 1 cm thick. Arrange in one layer, brush with oil and season.

timelineEn.label: First side
timelineEn.detail: 180°C for 8 minutes.

timelineEn.label: Turn
timelineEn.detail: Brush and season the other side; cook at 180°C for 5 minutes.

stepsEn: Cut the cooked mantou about 1 cm thick. Mix the salt, cumin and optional chili powder.
Arrange in a single layer without overlapping; work in batches if needed. Brush the top lightly with oil and add some seasoning.
Cook at 180°C for 8 minutes, then turn. Brush and season the other side and cook at 180°C for 5 more minutes.
Check for a dry surface and crisp edges. Remove when the texture suits you, before any blackening.
turnEn: Turn after 8 minutes, then cook 5 more minutes. Divide oil and seasoning between both sides.
completionEn: Both surfaces are dry and fragrant, edges crisp and the center hot. Avoid blackening.
advancePreparationEn: Use fully cooked, cooled mantou, not raw dough.
notesEn: The 10 g oil, 1 g salt, 1 g cumin and optional 0.5 g chili are editorial seasoning amounts. The original uses amounts to taste; these are not conversions of its spoons.
The independent comparison uses thinner slices coated in egg: preheat to 180°C, cook 4 minutes, turn and cook 2 minutes. Coating, thickness and method differ, so its 6-minute time is not used here.
This recipe has not been physically tested by this site.

descriptionZh: 买大号蛋挞皮，自己搅拌奶油蛋挞液；首批 180°C 预热 3 分钟，每批 12 分钟起检查。
portionZh: 大号蛋挞皮 15 个的配方；按炸篮大小分批平放
preheatDetailZh: 首批 180°C 预热 3 分钟；连续做第二批时，原作者不再预热，仍设 180°C 12 分钟。
ingredientsZh: 鸡蛋 3 个，原作者合计约 130 克

timelineZh.label: 搅拌蛋挞液
timelineZh.detail: 将牛奶、蛋、糖搅匀，再加淡奶油和炼乳。

timelineZh.label: 每批气炸
timelineZh.detail: 180°C 12 分钟起检查；连续第二批不重复预热。

stepsZh: 准备牛奶、糖和鸡蛋，搅拌至糖分散；加入炼乳与淡奶油，再搅匀。
蛋挞皮从冷冻取出分开，按主参考不专门等待完全解冻。空气炸锅首批以180°C预热3分钟。
先将蛋挞液倒到挞皮约六分满，平放入炸篮后再补到八九分满，避免移动时洒出。放不下分批。
180°C烤12分钟开始检查。中间已凝固、没有可流动的生蛋奶液，挞皮酥脆后取出；仍液态则保持180°C继续加热并复查。
连续做下一批时不再重复预热，仍从180°C 12分钟开始检查；未烤的蛋挞液和挞皮按包装要求冷藏或冷冻保存。
turnZh: 保持正面朝上；本主参考没有翻面步骤。
completionZh: 轻晃时中心已经凝固，切开不流出生蛋奶液，挞皮烤透酥脆；表面有颜色不能单独代表中心完成。
advancePreparationZh: 需要购买成品大号蛋挞皮；无需腌制，先搅拌蛋挞液。
deviceNoteZh: 不同挞皮大小与炸篮会改变加热进度；12分钟是检查点，不承诺所有机型到点都完成。
notesZh: 保留主参考15个大号蛋挞的全配方，没有按未知挞皮容积推算份量。
独立对照是8个挞皮、125毫升甜牛奶、2个蛋且不放淡奶油，180°C烤20分钟；预热和液体比例不同，未拼用其时间或第15分钟翻面做法。
完成检查、未烤材料保存提示为编辑操作说明；尚未经过本站实机烹饪测试。

descriptionEn: Use large ready-made tart shells and mix your own cream custard. Preheat the first batch at 180°C for 3 minutes; check each batch after 12 minutes.
portionEn: Recipe for 15 large tart shells; keep flat and cook in batches to fit your basket
preheatDetailEn: Preheat the first batch at 180°C for 3 minutes. The author skips another preheat for an immediately following batch and still uses 180°C for 12 minutes.
ingredientsEn: 3 eggs, about 130 g in the original recipe

timelineEn.label: Mix custard
timelineEn.detail: Combine milk, eggs and sugar, then add cream and condensed milk.

timelineEn.label: First preheat
timelineEn.detail: 180°C for 3 minutes.

timelineEn.label: Each batch
timelineEn.detail: Check after 12 minutes at 180°C. Do not repeat preheating for an immediately following batch.

stepsEn: Mix the milk, sugar and eggs until the sugar disperses. Stir in the condensed milk and cream.
Separate the frozen tart shells; the main source does not wait for them to thaw fully. Preheat the first batch at 180°C for 3 minutes.
Fill each shell about six-tenths full, place flat in the basket, then top up to eight- or nine-tenths full to avoid spilling while moving. Work in batches.
Cook at 180°C and start checking at 12 minutes. Remove when the center is set without flowing raw custard and the pastry is cooked and crisp. If still liquid, continue at 180°C and recheck.
For an immediately following batch, skip another preheat and again check after 12 minutes at 180°C. Store uncooked custard and shells chilled or frozen as appropriate to their packaging.
turnEn: Keep upright. The main source does not turn the tarts.
completionEn: The center holds its shape when gently moved and does not release raw custard when cut. Pastry is cooked and crisp. A browned top alone does not confirm the center is done.
advancePreparationEn: Buy large ready-made tart shells and mix the custard. No marinating required.
notesEn: The full 15-large-tart formula is retained; quantities were not calculated from an assumed shell volume.

The independent comparison uses 8 shells, 125 ml sweetened milk and 2 eggs without cream, cooking at 180°C for 20 minutes. Its different liquid proportions, preheat and turning step at 15 minutes are not combined with this method.
The finish check and storage notes are editorial handling advice. This recipe has not been physically tested by this site.
deviceNoteEn: Shell size and basket design affect progress. Twelve minutes is a checkpoint, not a guarantee for every appliance.

descriptionZh: 先把茄子烤软，再铺炒好的蒜酱短烤；需要炒锅和空气炸锅两种厨具。
portionZh: 茄子 1 根，切成两段，以能平放进炸篮为准
preheatDetailZh: 主参考直接装入茄子后设温，没有单列预热；本份不另外补入预热分钟。
ingredientsZh: 食用油 15 克，分刷茄子与炒酱用
小米椒 1 个，切碎，可不放

timelineZh.label: 同时炒蒜酱
timelineZh.detail: 中小火炒蒜、小米椒和萝卜干，加生抽。

stepsZh: 茄子洗净切成两段，表面薄刷油。放入炸篮，200°C烤20分钟，中途翻面。
烤茄子时，炒锅用中小火热油，放蒜末、小米椒碎和萝卜干碎，炒出香气后加入生抽拌匀，不把蒜炒黑。
将茄子从中间划开，用筷子摊开茄肉，表面再薄刷一点油，200°C烤5分钟。
用筷子确认茄肉已软，仍发硬时先继续烤软，再铺蒜酱。
铺上炒好的蒜酱，200°C短烤1分钟起检查，参考1–2分钟；蒜酱不焦后取出，撒孜然和葱花。
turnZh: 最初20分钟中途翻面；铺蒜酱后不翻面，短烤并留意蒜末。
completionZh: 茄肉能用筷子轻松分开、没有生硬处；加酱后蒜香明显且没有焦黑。茄肉未软时先完成烤软阶段，不能靠最后1–2分钟补足。
advancePreparationZh: 需要先切蒜和萝卜干，烤茄子时另用炒锅炒酱；无需提前腌制。
notesZh: 油15克、萝卜干10克、生抽10克、1个小米椒、1根葱和孜然0.5克是编辑选定的调味用量，不是原文“勺”或“适量”的换算。茄子1根、蒜1头沿用主参考。
主参考先200°C 20分钟，再200°C 5分钟烤软，最后1–2分钟烤酱。本份26–27分钟只计气炸，不含准备和炒酱时间。
独立对照懒饭用2根长茄子、170°C 25分钟，再160°C 5分钟，热油泼蒜酱；不同温度与酱料做法没有平均。
尚未经过本站实机烹饪测试。

descriptionEn: Roast the eggplant until soft, then briefly cook with pan-fried garlic sauce. Requires both a hob and an air fryer.
portionEn: 1 eggplant, cut into two sections that fit flat in the basket
preheatDetailEn: The main source loads the eggplant before setting the heat and gives no separate preheat. No preheat minutes have been added.
ingredientsEn: 1 whole head of garlic, peeled and minced
15 g cooking oil, divided between brushing and frying

timelineEn.label: Roast eggplant
timelineEn.detail: 200°C for 20 minutes, turning partway through.

timelineEn.label: Make sauce alongside
timelineEn.detail: Gently fry garlic, chili and radish over medium-low heat, then add soy sauce.

timelineEn.label: Open and soften
timelineEn.detail: Spread open the flesh; cook at 200°C for 5 more minutes.

timelineEn.label: Add sauce
timelineEn.detail: Spread the sauce and cook at 200°C for 1–2 minutes.

stepsEn: Wash and cut the eggplant into two sections. Brush lightly with oil and air fry at 200°C for 20 minutes, turning partway through.
Meanwhile, heat some oil in a frying pan over medium-low heat. Add garlic, optional chili and radish. Once fragrant, mix in soy sauce; do not blacken the garlic.
Slit open the cooked eggplant and spread the flesh with chopsticks. Brush lightly with a little oil and cook at 200°C for 5 minutes.
Check that the flesh is soft. If still firm, keep cooking until soft before adding the sauce.
Spread with the garlic sauce. Check after 1 minute at 200°C; the reference finish is 1–2 minutes. Remove before the garlic scorches, then add cumin and spring onion.
turnEn: Turn during the first 20 minutes. After adding sauce, keep upright and watch the garlic during the brief finish.
completionEn: Flesh separates easily with chopsticks without firm raw areas; the sauce is fragrant, without blackened garlic. Finish softening before adding sauce rather than relying on its final 1–2 minutes.
advancePreparationEn: Chop the garlic and radish and use a separate frying pan for the sauce while the eggplant roasts. No advance marinating required.
notesEn: Oil 15 g, radish 10 g, soy sauce 10 g, 1 chili, 1 spring onion and cumin 0.5 g are editorial seasoning amounts, not conversions of the author’s spoons or unspecified amounts. The eggplant and whole head of garlic follow the main source.
The main method uses 200°C for 20 minutes, 5 more minutes to soften, then 1–2 minutes with sauce. The 26–27 minutes count only air frying, excluding preparation and pan work.

The independent Lan Fan comparison uses 2 long eggplants at 170°C for 25 minutes, then 160°C for 5 minutes, and pours hot oil over its garlic mixture. Different sauce methods and temperatures were not averaged.
This recipe has not been physically tested by this site.

descriptionZh: 生土豆切块、沥干刷油，180°C先烤15分钟，翻面后再烤15分钟。
portionZh: 土豆2–3个，切成大小接近的家常小块；每批平铺，放不下分批
preheatDetailZh: 原作者装篮后开始加热，未另列预热；本份保留该顺序。

timelineZh.label: 切块沥干
timelineZh.detail: 切块，泡过水的充分沥干，再刷油调味。

timelineZh.label: 翻面再烤
timelineZh.detail: 补刷薄油，180°C再15分钟；总计30分钟起检查。

stepsZh: 土豆洗净，切成大小接近的小块。暂不入锅时可泡水防变色；烤前充分沥干表面水分。
把土豆块平铺入炸篮，刷一层薄油，按口味撒辣椒粉拌匀。放不下分批。
180°C烤15分钟，翻动土豆块，补刷剩余薄油，再以180°C烤15分钟。
用筷子扎较大土豆块的中心，松软无硬心后夹出；没软透则保持180°C继续加热，分段复查。
turnZh: 第15分钟翻动并补刷薄油。
completionZh: 较大块的中心可以用筷子轻松扎透，没有生硬心；表面金黄即可，不烤到焦黑。
advancePreparationZh: 不用先煮；切好如需等待可以泡水，入锅前沥干。
notesZh: 10克油、1克可选辣椒粉是编辑选定用量，并非原文“1勺油”“适量辣椒”的换算。
主参考给2–3个土豆，没有指定切块厘米数；本份不把家常小块改成无出处的精密尺寸，也不按重量推算时间。
独立对照飞利浦HD9220/HD9225手册为300–750克自制土豆块、180°C 12–18分钟、翻动、半汤匙油；同页注明冷启动另加3分钟。本份没有将其短时表格拼到作者30分钟路线。
尚未经过本站实机烹饪测试。

descriptionEn: Cut raw potatoes into chunks, drain and brush with oil. Cook at 180°C for 15 minutes, turn, then cook 15 minutes more.
portionEn: 2–3 potatoes in similarly sized small chunks; spread out and work in batches if needed
preheatDetailEn: The author starts heating after loading and lists no separate preheat. That sequence is retained.
ingredientsEn: 10 g cooking oil, divided between both sides

timelineEn.label: Cut and drain
timelineEn.detail: Cut into chunks; drain thoroughly after any soaking, then brush and season.

timelineEn.label: First side
timelineEn.detail: 180°C for 15 minutes.

timelineEn.label: Turn and finish
timelineEn.detail: Brush lightly again; cook 15 more minutes at 180°C. Check at 30 minutes total.

stepsEn: Wash and cut the potatoes into similarly sized small chunks. If waiting before cooking, hold in water to limit discoloration; drain the surfaces thoroughly before air frying.
Spread in the basket, brush with a thin coating of oil and toss with optional chili powder. Work in batches if needed.
Cook at 180°C for 15 minutes. Turn the chunks and brush with the remaining thin coating of oil, then cook at 180°C for 15 more minutes.
Pierce a larger chunk through the center with a chopstick. Remove when soft with no firm raw core. If necessary, continue at 180°C and recheck in short intervals.
turnEn: Turn after 15 minutes and brush with the remaining oil.
completionEn: A chopstick passes easily through a larger chunk with no firm raw center. Aim for golden surfaces, not blackening.
advancePreparationEn: No precooking required. If cut potatoes must wait, hold in water and drain before cooking.
notesEn: Oil 10 g and optional chili 1 g are editorial amounts, not conversions of the author’s spoon of oil or seasoning to taste.
The main source specifies 2–3 potatoes without a precise chunk size. No unsupported centimeter measurement or weight-based time calculation has been added.

The independent Philips HD9220/HD9225 table gives 300–750 g homemade potato cubes, 180°C for 12–18 minutes, turning and half a tablespoon of oil; the same page adds 3 minutes for cold starts. Its shorter table time is not combined with the author’s 30-minute method.
This recipe has not been physically tested by this site.

descriptionZh: 老豆腐泡水5分钟后切块沥干，200°C烤20分钟，中途翻面，出锅撒椒盐。
portionZh: 老豆腐约400克；单层留缝，放不下分批
preheatDetailZh: 主参考在炸篮底部刷油、摆豆腐后开始烤，未单列预热。
ingredientsZh: 老豆腐约400克，不用内酯豆腐代替
食用油5克，薄刷炸篮接触面

timelineZh.label: 泡水
timelineZh.detail: 清水浸泡5分钟，切块后沥干。

stepsZh: 老豆腐用清水浸泡5分钟，切成大小接近的小块，沥干并用厨房纸吸去表面水。
在炸篮与豆腐接触面刷薄油，豆腐单层摆开、块与块之间留缝，放不下分批。
选空气炸模式，200°C烤10分钟左右后翻面，继续烤至总计20分钟起检查。
两面金黄、表皮成形，切开中心也热透后夹出。没热透时保持200°C继续加热，分段检查。
出锅后撒椒盐及可选辣椒粉，稍放凉再吃。
turnZh: 约第10分钟翻面，后半段让另一面上色。
completionZh: 两面金黄、表皮成形，较大块切开内部热透；不以深褐或焦黑作为目标。
advancePreparationZh: 需要5分钟清水浸泡，不需腌制或预煮；选择老豆腐。
deviceNoteZh: 主参考使用宜盾普底部加热并带热风的机型；200°C 20分钟是该设备做法的起查参考。
notesZh: 5克油、1克椒盐、0.5克可选辣椒粉是编辑选定用量，原文仅写刷一层油和出锅撒椒盐/辣椒面。
独立对照HotomYes使用大宇K10，将老豆腐切小块，180°C先15分钟再翻面10分钟，并写明无需预热。设备与温度不同，未移植其冷启动声明。
原资料内的健康宣传和品牌性能评价未采用；尚未经过本站实机烹饪测试。

descriptionEn: Soak firm tofu for 5 minutes, cut and drain. Air fry at 200°C for 20 minutes, turning partway through, then add seasoned salt.
portionEn: About 400 g firm tofu; one layer with gaps, in batches if needed
preheatDetailEn: The main source brushes the basket, loads the tofu and starts cooking without listing a separate preheat.
ingredientsEn: About 400 g firm tofu, not silken tofu
5 g cooking oil, for a thin film on contact surfaces

timelineEn.label: Soak
timelineEn.detail: Soak in clean water for 5 minutes, then cut and drain.

timelineEn.label: Air fry
timelineEn.detail: Reference: 200°C for 20 minutes, turning around minute 10.

timelineEn.label: Season
timelineEn.detail: Add seasoned salt and optional chili powder.

stepsEn: Soak the firm tofu in clean water for 5 minutes. Cut into similarly sized small pieces, drain and blot off surface moisture.
Brush a thin film of oil on basket surfaces touching the tofu. Arrange in one layer with gaps; work in batches if needed.
Select Air Fry and cook at 200°C. Turn at around 10 minutes and start checking at 20 minutes total.
Remove when both sides are golden with a formed skin and a larger piece is hot through when cut. If needed, continue at 200°C and check in short intervals.
Sprinkle with seasoned salt and optional chili powder; let cool slightly before eating.
turnEn: Turn at about 10 minutes so the second side can color.
completionEn: Both sides are golden with a formed skin; the center of a larger piece is hot. Do not aim for dark brown or black surfaces.
advancePreparationEn: Soak for 5 minutes. No marinating or precooking required; use firm tofu.
notesEn: Oil 5 g, seasoned salt 1 g and optional chili 0.5 g are editorial amounts. The original specifies only a thin brushed coating and seasoning after cooking.

The independent HotomYes comparison uses a Daewoo K10: small firm-tofu pieces at 180°C for 15 minutes, then turning and 10 minutes more, explicitly without preheating. Its cold-start statement is not transferred to the different main-reference appliance.
Health claims and brand-performance claims from the source articles are omitted. This recipe has not been physically tested by this site.
deviceNoteEn: The main source uses an EdenPURE appliance with bottom heating and hot air. Its 200°C, 20-minute method supplies a starting checkpoint.

descriptionZh: 鲜香菇拌香料腌片刻，180°C预热后先烤10分钟，翻面再烤8分钟。
portionZh: 鲜香菇12朵，原作者约285克；单层摆放
preheatDetailZh: 主参考要求放进已预热的空气炸锅；预热到180°C，以机器就绪提示为准，不另补分钟数。
ingredientsZh: 玉米油10克，另留少量薄刷表面

timelineZh.label: 处理及拌料
timelineZh.detail: 去硬蒂、表面划花，洗净沥干后拌料。

timelineZh.label: 短腌与预热
timelineZh.detail: 香菇拌匀后放置片刻，同时预热到180°C。

stepsZh: 鲜香菇去硬蒂，可在菇帽表面浅划花刀，洗净后沥干。
把油、生抽和全部调味粉拌匀，放入香菇抓拌，放置片刻；同时把机器预热到180°C。
香菇菌褶朝上、菇帽朝下单层摆入炸篮，表面薄刷少量油，180°C烤10分钟。
翻面，另一面也薄刷少量油，保持180°C再烤8分钟。
确认香菇整体变软、中心热透后夹出；仍硬或中心不热，就以180°C继续加热并复查。
turnZh: 第10分钟翻面，补刷薄油后再烤8分钟。
completionZh: 菇肉整体熟软、较厚处也热透，没有生硬处；边缘干香，不烤黑。
advancePreparationZh: 鲜香菇拌调味后短暂放置入味，原文只说“片刻”，不强加具体腌制分钟。
notesZh: 原作者已注明大勺15毫升、小勺5毫升，但本份采用另一套编辑称量调味：油10克、生抽10克、孜然2克、辣椒1克、蒜粉1克、五香0.5克、胡椒0.5克、盐1克、糖3克；不是原文量勺的密度换算。
主参考12朵约285克、180°C 10+8分钟；独立厂商对照HD9257为约800克花菜和菇类、180°C 10分钟、冷启动、切块拌1汤匙油并翻动。对照是菇类混合蔬菜的基础表，不是同份完整香菇配方的重复验证，没有按份量换算或移植其冷启动规则。
尚未经过本站实机烹饪测试。

sources.locator: PDF第2页：蔬菜预设一行及空气煎炸说明

descriptionEn: Toss fresh shiitake in spices and let stand briefly. Preheat to 180°C, cook 10 minutes, turn and cook 8 minutes more.
portionEn: 12 fresh shiitake, about 285 g in the main source; one layer
preheatDetailEn: The main source uses a preheated air fryer. Preheat to 180°C until ready; no unsupported preheat duration has been added.
ingredientsEn: 10 g corn oil, plus a little for brushing

timelineEn.label: Prepare and coat
timelineEn.detail: Remove tough stems, score the caps, wash, drain and coat.

timelineEn.label: Brief marinade and preheat
timelineEn.detail: Let the coated mushrooms stand briefly while preheating to 180°C.

timelineEn.label: Air fry
timelineEn.detail: 180°C for 10 minutes, then turn and cook 8 more minutes.

stepsEn: Remove tough stems. Optionally score the caps shallowly, then wash and drain.
Mix oil, soy sauce and all seasonings. Toss the mushrooms to coat and let stand briefly while the fryer preheats to 180°C.
Arrange in one layer, gills up and caps down. Brush the surface lightly with a little oil and cook at 180°C for 10 minutes.
Turn, brush the other side lightly and continue at 180°C for 8 minutes.
Remove when soft throughout and hot through the thickest parts. If still firm or cool inside, continue at 180°C and recheck.
turnEn: Turn after 10 minutes, brush lightly and cook 8 more minutes.
completionEn: The mushrooms are soft throughout and hot through thick areas without raw, firm sections; edges are dry and fragrant rather than black.
advancePreparationEn: Let the seasoned fresh mushrooms stand briefly. The author specifies only a short rest, so no fixed marinating duration has been imposed.
notesEn: Although the author defines tablespoon as 15 ml and teaspoon as 5 ml, this recipe uses a separate editorial weighing plan: oil 10 g, soy sauce 10 g, cumin 2 g, chili 1 g, garlic 1 g, five-spice 0.5 g, pepper 0.5 g, salt 1 g and sugar 3 g. These are not density conversions of the original spoons.

The main method uses 12 mushrooms/about 285 g at 180°C for 10+8 minutes. The independent HD9257 table uses about 800 g cauliflower and mushrooms at 180°C for 10 minutes, cold-started, cut up and tossed with 1 tablespoon oil, with turning. This is a general mushroom-and-vegetable table, not a repeat validation of this exact shiitake recipe. No load conversion or transfer of its cold-start rule was made.
This recipe has not been physically tested by this site.

descriptionZh: 先把玉米煮熟，再200°C烤20分钟，期间转动几面；需要煮锅和空气炸锅。
portionZh: 玉米1–2根，以能单层放入炸篮为准（编辑小份安排）
preheatDetailZh: 主参考把煮熟玉米直接放入空气炸锅，没有另列预热。
ingredientsZh: 清水，煮锅内足以浸没玉米

timelineZh.label: 先煮熟
timelineZh.detail: 水开后煮15分钟起检查，至玉米熟透。

timelineZh.label: 沥水
timelineZh.detail: 取出沥去表面水，不额外刷酱。

stepsZh: 去掉玉米外叶和须，洗净。煮锅加水煮开，放入玉米，水开后煮15分钟起检查，继续至玉米粒熟软。
捞出沥去表面水，直接放入炸篮；较长而放不下时切段，单层摆开。
200°C烤20分钟，中途用夹子转动几面，让四周都受热。
表面有轻微烤香、内部仍熟软热透时夹出；已经达到喜欢的口感可提前取出，不追求焦黑。
turnZh: 烤制中多次转动，让圆柱形玉米各面都受热；原文未规定固定转动分钟。
completionZh: 入气炸前就应煮熟；出锅时中心热透、玉米粒熟软，表面略有烤香，不以焦黑作完成标准。
advancePreparationZh: 必须先煮熟，再连续气炸。本份不适用于生玉米直接套20分钟，也不作为隔夜玉米复热指南。
notesZh: 1–2根是为单层摆放选择的编辑小份，主参考没有规定根数；15分钟作为首次检查，需煮至熟透后才入气炸。
独立对照sding1126采用3根新鲜玉米、牛奶蜂蜜涂层和锡纸，200°C先10分钟翻面再8分钟，未写先煮步骤；本份采用先煮熟、无调味、裸烤路线，不把两套方法的食材状态或时间视为等价。
尚未经过本站实机烹饪测试。

sources.evidence: 新鲜玉米3根，刷牛奶蜂蜜、撒孜然黑胡椒；200°C先10分钟，翻面再8分钟，可打开锡纸继续烤；没有写先煮步骤。与主参考先煮熟、无酱、20分钟的方法不同，不将18分钟视为生熟等价。已打开全文。

descriptionEn: Boil the corn until cooked, then roast at 200°C for 20 minutes, rotating several times. Requires both a saucepan and an air fryer.
portionEn: 1–2 ears of corn that fit in one layer; an editorial small-batch choice
preheatDetailEn: The main source puts cooked corn straight into the air fryer without listing a separate preheat.
ingredientsEn: Enough water to cover the corn in the saucepan

timelineEn.label: Boil first
timelineEn.detail: Start checking after 15 minutes in boiling water; continue until cooked.

timelineEn.label: Drain
timelineEn.detail: Drain surface water. Do not add sauce.

timelineEn.label: Air fry
timelineEn.detail: 200°C for 20 minutes, rotating several times.

stepsEn: Remove husks and silk and wash the corn. Bring a saucepan of water to the boil, add the corn and start checking after 15 minutes of boiling. Continue until the kernels are cooked and tender.
Lift out and drain surface water, then put straight into the basket. Cut into sections if too long, and arrange in one layer.
Air fry at 200°C for 20 minutes, rotating with tongs several times so all sides face the heat.
Remove when lightly roasted outside and hot and tender inside. Take it out sooner if it has reached the texture you want; do not aim for blackening.
turnEn: Rotate several times during cooking so the cylindrical cobs heat on all sides. The source gives no fixed rotating minutes.
completionEn: The corn must be cooked before air frying. At serving it is hot through and tender with a lightly roasted surface, without blackening.
advancePreparationEn: Boil fully, then proceed directly to air frying. This 20-minute stage is not for raw corn and is not a reheating guide for corn stored overnight.
notesEn: One or two ears is an editorial single-layer portion; the main source specifies no count. Fifteen minutes is treated as the first boiling check, and corn must be cooked before air frying.

The independent sding1126 comparison uses 3 fresh ears with milk, honey and foil, cooking at 200°C for 10 minutes, then turning and cooking 8 minutes. It lists no boiling step. This recipe follows the main source’s precooked, unseasoned, uncovered method; food state and time are not treated as interchangeable.
This recipe has not been physically tested by this site.
